overview: The committee reviewed and voted on square footage efficiencies for academic, special education, and vocational spaces, resulting in an estimated $16.9 million in project savings. The body also voted to eliminate a proposed 'learn to swim' basin from the pool renovation to further manage the total project budget.

items.title: Call to Order and Minutes
items.summary: Approved the September 10, 2026, meeting minutes as amended to clarify that the project adds 11 MEEP classrooms to the high school specifically.

items.title: Core Academic Space Efficiencies
items.summary: Approved reducing the size of 48 general academic classrooms from 950 to 900 square feet to align with peer school districts. The committee rejected an amendment to size half the classrooms at 850 square feet in favor of maintaining a consistent 900-square-foot footprint.

items.title: Medford Academy Spaces
items.summary: Approved reducing Medford Academy classroom sizes to 900 square feet and sizing the workspace at 450 square feet to match general academic modules.

items.title: Special Education Spaces
items.summary: Approved space efficiencies across various special education programs, including resource rooms and administrative offices, resulting in a net reduction of 1,625 square feet.

items.title: Chapter 74 CTE Spaces
items.summary: Approved revised shop and related classroom square footages for Career Technical Education programs, yielding 6,153 net square feet in savings. Adjustments included shared toilet facilities between shops and matching shop sizes to current student enrollment data.

items.title: Non-Chapter 74 Lab Spaces
items.summary: Approved maintaining the square footage for non-vocational labs, including digital art, media technology, and a culinary-focused innovation lab, without further reductions.

items.title: Media Center
items.summary: Approved the media center layout and square footage, which remains within MSBA guidelines and incorporates collaborative quiet rooms and a small cafe space.

items.title: Cost and Savings Summary
items.summary: Reviewed a summary of the evening's approved efficiencies, which total over 15,000 gross square feet and approximately $16.9 million in potential savings.

items.title: Pool Design Update and Decision
items.summary: Voted to eliminate a proposed $7.6 million 'learn to swim' basin addition from the project scope to prioritize academic costs. The project will proceed with the base renovation of the existing pool facilities only.
